controls: full-state downstream identity gives exact response
same report-pair collision and signed-change decoder collision separated
holdout model/report hashes sealed before evaluating test
test cases and intervention magnitudes never used for feature or ridge selection
three predetermined model seeds; all seed results retained

costs.decoder: 10B binary64 coefficients; one fixed 10-vector baseline-only intercept
costs.encoder: number of nonzero fixed integer weights plus B thresholds, coefficient magnitude/precision retained
costs.learned_feature_warning: PCA is a learned linear direction baseline, not an SAE and not a semantic explanation
costs.transmission: B bits per state; 2B bits for the pair

dataset.name: sklearn bundled UCI optical handwritten digits
dataset.writer_identity: not supplied; random stratified image split does not establish writer independence

decoder.baseline_class_readout: same B applied to T(h), with discovery-fit natural-state mean residual as intercept; diagnostic only
decoder.class: linear in signed predicate differences; no intercept or interactions for response
decoder.formula: B times (T(hprime)-T(h)); one shared B across groups, strengths and natural pairs
decoder.ridge_selection: lowest discovery-validation response MSE; first grid value breaks ties

interventions.definition: hprime_j=(1-strength)*h_j in one fixed 8-unit group; others unchanged
interventions.natural_bank: cyclic pairs of distinct held-out inputs, replacing the whole nominated hidden state; separately reported
interventions.off_manifold: group-damped hidden states are controlled mathematical interventions, not asserted to be natural images

metrics.collision_certificate: within-report-pair coordinate range exceeds twice tolerance, exact integer comparisons; complete bank
metrics.coverage: finite-bank statements, no population or semantic-completeness certification
metrics.decoder_summary_floor: same variance after signed-difference aggregation, separately named
metrics.information_floor: empirical within-identical-report-pair conditional variance; in-sample finite-bank oracle only
metrics.primary_target: 10 centered logit changes (sum over outputs for squared error)

model.export: weights and biases rounded to integer / 4096; exact integer ReLU and centered-logit target

repair.candidate_pool: native predicates at training quartiles 0.25,0.5,0.75, with duplicate integer predicates removed
repair.claim: measured discovery-selected refinement; success not assumed
repair.naive_cost_matched: 12-bit native median report from original greedy ranking
repair.selection: four greedy additions minimizing discovery-fit response MSE, selection ridge=0.01; no validation or test targets in feature choice

report.candidate_ranking: greedy discovery-fit response mean-square error with selection ridge=0.01; same procedure for all families
report.context: none; no input identity, label, intervention id or hidden state supplied to decoder
report.native_candidates: 32 individual units thresholded at train median
report.native_groups: 16 disjoint pairs, greedily strongest positive Pearson coactivation on training states; sum thresholded at train median
report.pca_candidates: 32 training covariance eigenvectors, integer coefficients rounded at scale4096, training-median predicates
report.quantiles: sorted integer linear-projection element at floor(q*(n-1)); predicate uses strict greater-than

split.independent_units: three model initialisations and held-out images; interventions of an image are dependent

status: frozen before training, report selection, or test evaluation; local prospective split, not external preregistration
